evals.name: documentary-animation
evals.prompt: BD says we're missing tenders for documentaries and animation videos. Can you make sure those get picked up?
evals.expected_output: Searches the raw store for real examples, adds narrow patterns to [agencies].ad, previews with rules_diff.py, adds a test using real titles, runs pytest, applies with reclassify, reports new/dropped/changed with real titles and links.
expectations: Searched the stored raw items for real examples before editing the rules
Edited rules.toml with targeted, phrase-level patterns for documentary/animation work (no bare common words)
Ran rules_diff.py and reported NEW / DROPPED / CHANGED counts
Added a test that uses a real title (from a fixture or the raw store), and the full test suite passes
The report states the effect honestly, including when there are 0 new matches in stored data

evals.name: drop-board-changes
evals.prompt: The board_change filings (director resignations, company secretary appointments) are noise for us. Stop them showing up as leads, but keep CEO changes.
evals.expected_output: Changes PSX rules in sources.toml (not individual leads), previews the effect, keeps leadership_change filings, lists dropped leads with statuses and asks before marking them dropped, adds a test, reclassifies.
expectations: Changed the PSX title rules in sources.toml (or the scoring) rather than editing individual leads
CEO / president / chief executive change filings still produce leads after the change
Ran rules_diff.py and listed the dropped leads with their current statuses
Did not change any lead's status; asked the user before marking dropped leads
Added a test using real filing titles, and the full test suite passes
